# FieldData

FieldData reports what a grower's own weather station and soil probes measured.
It is a Tollbooth DPYC™ operator, paid per call in sats from a pre-funded balance.

MCP endpoint: https://fielddata-mcp.fastmcp.app/mcp
Source: https://github.com/lonniev/fielddata-mcp

Pages: / /how /prices /catalog /sources /terms
The Catalog shows the Good Brew café's collections, read live from https://cafe.tollbooth-dpyc.com; orders are placed at the café.
